sentences.text: OFFI No. NOT 04. 08.07.2025 SV,J  I.A.No.2 of 2025 in  M.A.C.M.A.No.400 of 2025  This application is filed to grant stay of operation of  decree and judgment, dated 09.09.2024 in M.V.O.P.No.372  of 2012 on the file of the Court of learned VII Additional  District Judge at Peddapuram, pending disposal of the  appeal.

entities.text: VII Additional  District Judge at Peddapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Sri Naresh Byrapaneni, learned counsel for the  petitioner/appellant/insurer submits that as per Ex.A.1 the  accident was a hit and run and the alleged offending vehicle  is planted with the help of police to get the compensation,
 thereby, there are good grounds to succeed in the appeal.

He further strenuously contends that there is no  application of Order XLI of C.P.C. in view of the specific  provision under M.V. Act, which is a complete Code by itself,
 thereby, this Court can grant interim stay even before  admission of the appeal as well deciding the delay condone  application.

In support of the said contentions, he relied  upon the three Judge Bench decision of this Court in  BadanaboylnaVeeraNageswara Rao v. Badanaboyina  Rama Devi (1997 SCC Online AP 637), which is relied upon  in another decision of this Court in National Insurance  Cond  Company Limited v. M.Mothi Kiran (M.A.C.M.A.MP.No.2802 of 2017 in M.A.C.M.A.No.1510 of 2017 decided on 18.07.2017).

entities.text: BadanaboylnaVeeraNageswara Rao v. Badanaboyina  Rama Devi (1997 SCC Online AP 637)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: National Insurance  Cond  Company Limited v. M.Mothi Kiran (M.A.C.M.A.MP.No.2802 of 2017
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above submissions, this Court closely perused the law cited and relied upon by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

The Division Bench of this Court in Badanaboyina Rama Devicase (referred to supra), which is followed in M.Mothi Kiran case (referred to supra),
elaborately considered the scope of the rules of High Court on Appellate side and categorically held that the appeals under Special Statues must be listed before the Judge as per the roster and that there is a specific bar under Rule 473 of the A.P. Motor Vehicle Rules 1989 regarding application of procedure of C.P.C. and concluded that Order XLI of C.P.C. has no application in view of specific provision under M.V.Act, which is a complete code by itself, thereby, in view of the settled legal position and as the law referred above United India Insurance Company Limited vs Kommana Krishna Murthy on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121255769/
1 became final, this Court has no hesitation to grant interim stay even before deciding the condone delay application.

entities.text: United India Insurance Company Limited vs Kommana Krishna Murthy on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Having regard to the above settled legal position, this application is ordered, consequently, there shall be interim stay of execution of Award and Decree,dated 09.09.2024 passed in M.V.O.P.No.372of 2012on the file of the MACT- cum-VII Additional District Judge at Peddapuram, subject to deposit of 50% of the awarded amount within a period of eight (08) weeks from today.
 I.A.No.1 of 2025 in  M.A.C.M.A.No.400 of 2025  Issue notice to respondents.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Cond- Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice on the respondents by Registered Post with Acknowledgement Due and file proof of service in the Registry.
